findings.text: The body is offered, and washed, with the heart: present your bodies as a living sacrifice, which is your spiritual worship (Rom 12:1); let us draw near with a true heart, with our hearts sprinkled clean from an evil conscience and our bodies washed with pure water (Heb 10:22).

The body is a dwelling, and not one's own: your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit within you, whom you have from God; you are not your own, for you were bought with a price, so glorify God in your body (1 Cor 6:19-20).
The body apart from the spirit: absent in body, present in spirit (1 Cor 5:3); the body apart from the spirit is dead (Jas 2:26); the body is dead because of sin, the Spirit is life (Rom 8:10).

In Heb 10:22 (hearts sprinkled clean from an evil conscience and bodies washed with pure water) and 1 Cor 6:19-20 (your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit; you are not your own; glorify God in your body), the verse joins the body to the inner act.
